free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: required positional coverage ratio; must lie in (0,1); the target guard does not use it

free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: smallest non-degenerate head count for the shape checks after the target

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: equal to num_q_heads so the later GQA divisibility check is trivially satisfied

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: smallest head_dim accepted by the downstream head_dim checks

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: repository default block size, accepted by the downstream block-size checks

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: the dtype the downstream kernels require; irrelevant before the batch-size assertion

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed RNG seed for deterministic tensor construction

free_parameters.name: tau
free_parameters.why: repository default query-aware head threshold; unused by the target guard

free_parameters.name: min_budget
free_parameters.why: repository default (becomes 1 inside the function); unused by the target guard

free_parameters.name: max_budget
free_parameters.why: repository default (becomes 2^31-1 inside the function); unused by the target guard

free_parameters.name: gqa_interleave
free_parameters.why: repository default GQA pattern; unused by the target guard

free_parameters.name: softmax_scale
free_parameters.why: repository default (sqrt(head_dim)); unused by the target guard

free_parameters.name: return_computational_ratio
free_parameters.why: repository default; only changes the return value after the target

mocks.reason: GPU-only block-pool launcher, reached in get_active_blocks after the target assertion on the batch_size==1 run; replaced by a plain-torch average pool
GPU-only attention launcher, reached at the end of flex_prefill_attention after the target assertion; replaced by the repository's own torch_block_wise_attention reference
